scripts.build: bun run check && bun run build:bundle
scripts.build:browser: bun -e "process.env.GM_CLIENT_ALLOW_DUMMY='1'; process.env.GM_CLIENT_BUILD_PROFILE='dev'; process.env.GM_CLIENT_REVISION='browser-test'; delete process.env.VERSION; const result = Bun.spawnSync(['bun', 'run', 'build:bundle'], { cwd: '.', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit', env: process.env }); process.exit(result.exitCode);"
scripts.test:browser: bun run build:browser && bun test browser --parallel=3 --path-ignore-patterns=**/presentation-performance.test.ts --no-orphans --timeout 30000 && bun test ./browser/presentation-performance.test.ts --no-orphans --timeout 30000
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:e2e-harness && bun test e2e --no-orphans --timeout 60000
